'''Tresfor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked at [[Ja'Boag]]'s facility on [[Moorjhone]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Tresfor oversaw the recoveries of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Judd]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]] after their fight with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Dray had his hands reattached in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] while Judd's broken arm healed. Upon Judd's questioning of Tresfor regarding the inhabitants of Moorjthone and their livelihood under the rule of Ja'boag, the Twi'lek at first backed away. Upon further investigation by Judd, Tresfor told him to look to the skies for his answer and noted that the [[Day of Three Suns]] was drawing near.
